entry.content:
Built in 1783 by French Huguenots, this stone house in Lexington, New York, is an unusually early example of Catskills stone construction. Heavy hand-hewn beams, wide-plank floors, thick stone and plaster walls and original hearths remain, and a 2016 renovation added radiant floors, new plumbing and electrical, and a standing-seam roof. A connected 18th-century timber-framed artist's studio has north-facing windows, a woodstove and a mezzanine with sleeping quarters. The 155 acres were once a cattle farm and later a flower farm, and now hold an orchard, magnolias, peonies, trails and a cedar hot tub. The land runs along more than a quarter mile of Schoharie Creek and borders thousands of acres of state land.

entry.content:
In 2001, the Freak watch launched without a dial and started a design lineage that continues to this day. To celebrate its 25th anniversary and Ulysse Nardin's 180th, the newest edition of the Freak shows the hours on a disc cut from howlite, a marble-like white mineral. Ulysse Nardin sourced the howlite in Canada and rejected about 60 percent of it to keep only what met its standards for color and veining. A flying carousel that turns once an hour acts as the minute hand, and the 45mm titanium case houses a self-winding movement with a 72-hour power reserve. Only 15 will be made.

entry.content:
Ljus is Swedish for light, a fitting name for the collaboration between Nordic design houses Byredo and Iittala, a collection of handblown glass objects that showcase the interaction of flame, smoke, glass, and light. The centerpiece of the collection, the light refractor, encases a candle so the flame shows through the glass, and the fragrance diffuser vessel echoes that silhouette. A candle ornament rests on a lit candle to catch and scatter its flame, and a thick candle stand and an incense holder with the same ornate silhouettes complete the set. Each is made at Iittala's factory in Finland, so every one differs slightly, and all are designed to pair with Byredo candles and incense.
